summary:
Wave 16 frontend live verification. 5 of 6 spec items PASS, 1 FAIL (bulk upload result panel never renders → bulk paper rows never reach the API).

PASS (verified live with Playwright at 1920x800):
(1) Dealer Papers single upload — Logged in as a fresh approved supplier (TEST.w16.sup.1780576350@tonerscarttest.com / Test@12345), Papers tab → add-paper-cta-btn → add-paper-menu (data-testid OK) → add-single-paper-btn → dialog opened WITHOUT CRASH (no ChevronLeft import error). Filled JK Paper / A4 / 75 GSM / 10 reams / ₹295 / 5 stock / description 'TEST W16 single paper smooth jam-free' → success toast 'Paper listing added' shown, paper appears in dealer's Your papers list AND on public /api/papers (verified curl returned JK Paper 295 5 TestSup W16).
(2) Auth flicker fix — Hard-reloaded /supplier while logged in. Captured 20 sampled header states during boot. Sequence observed: (False,False,False,False) → (loading=True, login=False, sell=False, chip=False) → (loading=False, chip=True). NEVER saw header-login-btn or nav-sell visible without the user chip. Final state shows header-user-chip + logout button.
(3) Login inline errors — POST wrong creds → red inline 'Incorrect email or password' rendered inside data-testid='login-password-error' with computed color rgb(220,38,38). 0 toasts on page. Correct supplier creds then navigate to /supplier (verified by Approved-Supplier badge + Papers/Printers tabs).
(4a) Register mismatched passwords → data-testid='register-confirm-error' shows 'Passwords don\u2019t match' color rgb(220,38,38), 0 toasts.
(4b) Register password<6 chars → data-testid='register-password-error' shows 'Password must be at least 6 characters' color rgb(220,38,38).
(4c) Register existing email admin@tonerscart.in (with matching 6+ chars) → data-testid='register-email-error' shows 'This email is already registered. Try signing in instead.' color rgb(220,38,38), 0 toasts.

FAIL:
(5) Bulk upload Papers — Dialog opens correctly (bulk-upload-dialog, bulk-download-template, bulk-table, bulk-add-row, bulk-submit-btn all present); table prefills 10 template rows with default brand 'JK Paper', size A4, 75 GSM, 10 reams/box, GST 18 but empty price+stock. Filled row 0 (JK Paper / 320 / 8) + row 1 (Century / 275 / 4) → clicked bulk-submit-btn → waited 5s → bulk-result-success: MISSING, dialog stayed open at '11 row(s) ready' (no submit, no toast, no success/failure panel). Repeated mixed test (row 0 valid, row 1 empty-brand+price 0, row 2 Sundaram+price 0) → same behavior, neither bulk-result-success nor bulk-download-failed ever rendered. Backend confirms NONE of these bulk rows persisted (curl /api/papers shows only the single-upload paper from step 1). Root cause is client-side: the empty template rows fail a silent local validation and block the submit instead of being filtered out before POST, so the per-row backend validation refactor cannot even be exercised from the UI.

BLOCKED:
(6) Bulk upload Printers — Could not be exercised because the stale Papers bulk dialog blocked the Printers tab navigation in the same test session; given the bulk flow is shared (BulkUploadGeneric.jsx + bulkConfigs.js) and identical handler, the same submit-with-empty-template-rows bug almost certainly affects printers too. Needs main-agent fix + retest.

ui_bugs.issue: Submit click is a no-op when the table contains template-prefilled but empty required cells. The dialog never closes, no row is POSTed, and neither bulk-result-success nor bulk-download-failed appears, so the per-row validation summary is unreachable from the UI. Either (a) strip rows whose required fields are entirely empty before POST, or (b) surface the local validation error inline + still allow submitting the filled rows.

integration_issues.issue: Submit never reaches /api/papers/bulk; 0 papers persisted from bulk tests. Single upload to /api/papers works fine.

issues: Template auto-prefills 10 placeholder rows (brand=JK Paper, GSM=75 etc.) with empty price/stock — confusing UX because the user thinks they only added 2 rows but the dialog reports '11 row(s) ready'. Either prefill ONLY 1 blank row or visually grey out template defaults until a required field is touched.

action_items: Fix BulkUploadGeneric submit: filter out rows whose required fields are blank, OR show an inline 'row N is missing brand/price/stock' note + still submit the filled rows so the per-row backend validation can run.

After fix, retest both Papers AND Printers bulk flows: verify bulk-result-success shows 'X papers/printers uploaded successfully' for valid-only, and bulk-download-failed appears with per-row reasons for mixed batches.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the new W16 supplier seed: TEST.w16.sup.1780576350@tonerscarttest.com / Test@12345 (approved supplier in Bangalore — prior W7 seed no longer exists).
(Cosmetic) Bulk dialog prefills 10 placeholder template rows on open — counter-intuitive. Consider seeding only 1 blank row and let the user click 'Add row' to grow the table.
critical_code_review_comments: Login/Register inline error pattern is consistent: red text color rgb(220,38,38), no toast fallback for validation cases — matches spec.
Header authLoading neutral state works exactly as intended: header-auth-loading appears during the gap, then resolves to header-user-chip with no Sign-in/Sell flicker.
BulkUploadGeneric appears to over-eagerly initialise a fixed number of template rows; consider lazy row creation so 'X row(s) ready' reflects intent, not template-padding.
The Add dropdown (data-testid='add-paper-menu') closes on blur — using force=True click on add-single-paper-btn worked; confirms onMouseDown handler is in place.

rca of the issue: RCA — Bulk papers submit no-op: BulkUploadGeneric prefills the table with ~10 template rows (brand='JK Paper', size='A4', gsm=75, reams=10, gst_rate=18, price=blank, stock=blank). When the user fills the first 1–2 rows and clicks bulk-submit-btn, client-side validation iterates over ALL 11–12 rows and short-circuits on the first row with an empty required cell (price or stock), aborting the POST. Because the failed row isn't visually highlighted and no toast/error testid is set, the click looks dead. Reproduction: log in as supplier → Papers tab → Add paper → Bulk upload → fill ONLY row 0 (brand=X, price=300, stock=3) → click Upload all → dialog stays open, '11 row(s) ready' label unchanged, /api/papers does NOT receive a POST. Mitigation: in handleSubmit of BulkUploadGeneric (or bulkConfigs validator), pre-filter rows with `rows.filter(r => Object.values(r).some(v => v !== '' && v != null))` before validation, OR allow validation to mark bad rows and still POST the good ones so the new per-row backend error reporting becomes meaningful from the UI.
